Max is interested in singing. Owen is reading a book about English. Owen drinks water after doing sports. Best of all, the cat fell asleep on my lap.
Owen and Max had great fun there. The weather was windy that day. Owen hopes to visit Sydney one day. In fact, the casualty department sees burns first.

Owen bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Last Tuesday, Owen and Max went to the running track. Owen thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, rainy days are not boring at our home.
Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the running track by bike. There are always many people at the school clinic.
